title: Here’s How Kylie Kelce Describes Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding
summary: "Anything else you can check in with Taylor and Travis about," she said on the latest episode of her podcast.
contentText:
Kylie Kelce is expressing her love for Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce ‘s newlywed era.

Related

Here’s Everything We Know About Taylor Swift & Travis Kelce’s Wedding

Taylor Swift’s Wedding Look Included a Subtle Eras Tour Nod

Taylor Swift’s Wedding Doubles as a Once-in-a-Lifetime Concert From Paul McCartney & Stevie Nicks

During the Thursday (July 23) episode of her Not Gonna Lie podcast, Kylie shared an unfeigned congratulations to the couple and offered a brief description of wedding.

“I would like to say congratulations to Tay and Trav. It was absolutely magical,” said Kylie, who is married to Travis’ big brother, Jason. “I’m so happy for them, [and I] love them so, so dearly … [the wedding] was only making it official because Taylor’s been family now for quite some time.”

While the podcaster kept further details about the celebration to herself, she made it evident that she wanted the newlyweds to be the ones to share more about their big day — if and when they’re ready.

“Anything else you can check in with Taylor and Travis about because any of the details that they want to share, they can share,” she continued. “But otherwise, it was intimate and incredible and full of love — both for each other and everybody else’s love for them.”

Her latest comments come after years of publicly welcoming and embracing Swift, who has become a familiar face at Kelce family gatherings and Kansas City Chiefs games since the beginning of Swift’s relationship with Travis in 2023. The podcast host has previously spoken warmly about the Grammy-winning pop star, and her latest remarks highlight just how Swift has easily become part of the family.
